features.name: Multiple VAT numbers for customers
features.description: Customers can have alternative VAT registration numbers for different countries they operate in. One VAT number per country per customer, with optional VAT and general business posting groups.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is available in a public preview and it will be available for 25.0 version
caveats: Only one VAT number per customer per country
Currently limited to customers, not yet for vendors or company

features.name: Alternative customer VAT registration table
features.description: A configuration table where users can define all customers and the countries they operate in, storing VAT registration numbers and business posting groups per country.

features.name: Automatic VAT notification on ship-to address creation
features.description: When creating a ship-to address with a different country code, the system notifies users to create alternative VAT registration if not already configured.

features.name: VAT number application in sales documents
features.description: Sales documents automatically use the configured alternative VAT number based on the selected ship-to address country. Users receive a confirmation dialog showing the VAT number change before accepting.
caveats: Confirmation dialog can be disabled by user

features.name: VAT country region code field in documents
features.description: New field VAT country region code added to sales documents alongside VAT registration number, posted to VAT entries for filtering by country.

features.name: Custom address option in sales documents
features.description: Users can manually enter a custom ship-to address instead of selecting from configured alternatives, with manual country selection triggering VAT number lookup.

features.name: Country region filter in VAT return
features.description: New country region filter field in VAT return suggest lines functionality allowing filtering by single or multiple countries, with exclusion option.

features.name: Country region filter in VAT settlement
features.description: Country region filter field added to calculate and post VAT settlement batch job for filtering VAT entries by country.

features.name: Ship-to alternate customer VAT registration interface
features.description: Interface allowing developers to implement custom logic for handling country changes on ship-to addresses through the handle country change method.

features.name: Alternative customer VAT registration consistency interface
features.description: Interface for implementing custom logic to ensure alternative VAT registrations are only configured for countries different from the customer base country.

features.name: Alternative customer VAT registration document interface
features.description: Interface with multiple methods for customizing VAT number behavior in sales documents on record initialization, customer copy, address change, and country change scenarios.
